name: Implement mockup
description:
1. Analyzed the wall mockup against the codx-junior codebase and produced a full component inventory (61 visual components + 9 logic modules) before any coding.
2. Implemented the Activity Wall as a self-contained `src/components/wall/` set using daisyUI tokens and the codx-junior logo only — no third-party branding.
3. Registered the wall as the mobile home via a route guard in `navigate.js` (keeping `<RouterView>` always mounted), added "Activity" entries to `AppsSection` and `MainMenuItems`, and removed the app-level `MobileBottomBar` in favor of the wall's own `WallBottomNav`.
4. Reviewed the implementation against the mobile mockup and fixed the reported defects: invisible activity filters (merged into a single sticky header), broken author avatars (multi-key account indexing + circular fallback), and poor mockup fidelity (centered grid, refined post card/action bar, composer toolbar + counter).
5. Final state: the wall lives only in `src/components/wall/`, is mobile-home by default, opens the sidebar through `$storex.ui.expandSidebar()`, and feeds from real stores (`$chats`, `$storex.meets`, `$storex.kanban`, `$storex.api.userNetwork`).
